purpose: Independently confirm that a visual MOVE cue is issued only after stable centred speaker/face association, and otherwise times out without a movement instruction.

coordinate_frame.yaw: front 0 degrees; diagram-left negative; diagram-right positive
coordinate_frame.pitch: camera optical axis 0 degrees; up positive; down negative
coordinate_frame.distance: 1 metre horizontal radius from Reachy camera axis

steps.title: Association-gated centre-to-down transition
steps.instruction: Start at front 0°, exactly 1 m away, with your eye line on the camera optical-centre mark. From RECORDING, repeat ‘Reachy, this is an association-gated tracking test.’ clearly about every 1.5 seconds. Only if the full-screen MOVE DOWN cue appears, stop speaking, change to your eye line 17.6 cm below the camera optical-centre mark, and keep one full face visible until recording ends. If a red NO MOVE timeout appears, do not move.

steps.title: No-cue control: silent centred face
steps.instruction: Stay at front 0°, exactly 1 m away, with your eye line on the camera optical-centre mark. Remain silent, keep one full face visible, and do not move. The correct result is a red NO MOVE timeout with no green MOVE cue.

steps.title: No-cue control: speech without a visible face
steps.instruction: Keep every person completely outside Reachy’s camera view. From RECORDING, play or speak the association-gated test phrase from front 0° about every 1.5 seconds. Do not enter view and do not move. The correct result is a red NO MOVE timeout with no green MOVE cue.

steps.title: No-cue control: associated but not centred
steps.instruction: Stay at front 0°, exactly 1 m away, with your eye line 17.6 cm above the camera optical-centre mark. From RECORDING, repeat the association-gated test phrase clearly about every 1.5 seconds. Remain at that mark and do not move. The correct result is a red NO MOVE timeout because centred readiness was never established.
